name: Setting
description: Settings row and group pattern for preference surfaces: label and description on the start side, control slot at the end, optional badge, warning, and nested content.

description.description: Muted supporting copy under the label.

badge.description: Badge next to the label (string renders a Face UI Badge, e.g. "Beta").

warning.description: Cautionary copy rendered with a warning icon under the description.

control.description: Control slot rendered at the end of the row (toggle, select, buttons…).

layout.description: 'row' keeps the control inline at the end; 'stack' renders it full-width below the info block.

align.description: Vertical alignment of info vs control in row layout.

disabled.description: Dim the row and disable pointer interactions.

children.description: Nested full-width content under the row (previews, expanded editors…).

props.label: System notifications
props.description: Show a system notification when the agent completes or needs attention.

props.label: Instant grep index
props.description: Automatically index repositories to speed up searches. All data is stored locally.

props.label: Ignore symlinks
props.warning: Use with caution. Only enable if all ignore files are reachable without symlinks.

props.label: Cloud sync
props.description: Requires signing in to a workspace account.

notes: Setting is a layout pattern: labels and descriptions render through the Face UI Text primitive, badges through Badge, warnings through Icon.
Framed groups draw the shared border tokens and hairline separators between rows; rows inherit the group radius on the first and last row.
The highlighted state reuses the shared hover background token so deep-link emphasis stays monochrome.

whenToUse: Preference and settings rows with a trailing control
Grouped option lists with section titles
Feature toggles with explanatory copy, badges, or warnings
whenNotToUse: Standalone form fields inside forms (use Input, Select, Checkbox directly)
